_comment: SEED policy, copied to exec-policy.json on first use. exec-policy.json itself is LOCAL-ONLY and never replicated: it names the images allowed to execute code on this host and the caps they run under, so a peer able to supply it would choose what runs on your machine. Edit your local copy, not this one. Images must be listed here by tag before a workflow spec may request them; unknown image => refused. Digests are resolved at run time and recorded in provenance, because tags drift and a tag alone silently unpins the userland.
